note: L11 (awkit-djnl.19) parser-only DOM-intelligence runtime. The staging script (scripts/prepare-dom-intelligence-host.mjs) refuses any input whose SHA-256 differs from this pin, and the host refuses a Scrapling release other than 'scrapling'. Build-time inputs only: nothing here is ever downloaded at run time.

python.provenance: SHA-256 from the release's SPDX SBOM (python-3.12.10-embed-amd64.zip.spdx.json) and MD5 from the python.org 3.12.10 release page, both published by python.org

wheels.license: BSD-3-Clause (the Windows wheel statically bundles libxml2, libxslt and libexslt, MIT; zlib, Zlib; libiconv, LGPL-2.1)

correspondingSources.note: Owner decision 2026-10-01 for LGPL-2.1 section 6: lxml's Windows wheel statically links libiconv, so the complete corresponding source and the means to rebuild lxml against a modified libiconv ship inside the package at resources/native-hosts/dom-intelligence/sources/. Provenance: the pinned wheel equals PyPI's lxml-6.1.3-cp312-cp312-win_amd64.whl, uploaded 2026-09-02. lxml's buildlibxml.py takes Windows libraries from the newest lxml/libxml2-win-binaries release, then 2026.05.17 (iconv-1.17.1.win64.zip), whose build.ps1 builds the libiconv submodule at the pinned commit with its libiconv.patch. The two GitHub archives' SHA-256 values were measured on first download (2026-10-01) after their git-archive commit matched the pin; the lxml sdist's is PyPI's published digest.

archives.role: lxml's own source and build scripts (buildlibxml.py, setup.py), to rebuild the extension modules

archives.license: LGPL-2.1-or-later (the library; its utilities are GPL-3.0-or-later)
archives.role: the GNU libiconv source with winlibs' MSVC projects and patch, at the commit the libxml2-win-binaries submodule pins (its release names the build iconv-1.17.1)

archives.license: NOASSERTION (no license file; its libiconv.patch modifies the LGPL libiconv)
archives.role: tag 2026.05.17: build.ps1 and libiconv.patch, which build the static iconv-1.17.1 that lxml's wheel links
